en.title: Forward-to-bot inbox triggers
en.summary: Your Grok Bot has its own email inbox—an email can trigger a routine. Forward a receipt, invoice, or messy meeting notes and the matching workflow runs. No app to open: just hit Forward.
en.whyItWorks: The bottleneck is opening another app. Email-forward triggers meet work where it already lives, so intake becomes a single gesture.
workflowSteps: Locate your bot’s email address / inbox.
Define 2–3 email-triggered routines (e.g. receipt filing, invoice parse, meeting-notes cleanup).
Teach the bot how to detect which routine fits (subject keywords, sender, or a tag you add when forwarding).
Forward a sample of each type and verify the routine output.
Standardize a forward habit: add a short prefix like [receipt] / [invoice] / [notes] when helpful.
en.promptTemplate:
You have an email inbox that triggers routines.

Routines:
1) [receipt] — extract merchant, date, amount, category; return a one-line ledger entry.
2) [invoice] — extract vendor, due date, amount, pay status; list open questions.
3) [notes] — turn messy meeting notes into decisions, owners, and next actions.

On each inbound email: detect routine (from tag/subject/body), run it, reply with structured output. If unsure which routine, ask one clarifying question.
en.connectorsAndRoutines: Bot inbox + on-email routines are the core. Optional Gmail filters that auto-forward labeled mail. Keep payment or send-external actions behind confirmation.
acceptanceChecklist: Forwarding a receipt, an invoice, or messy meeting notes to the bot inbox runs the matching routine, without opening another app.
A [receipt] message comes back as a one-line ledger entry with merchant, date, amount, and category.
A [invoice] message comes back with vendor, due date, amount, pay status, and a list of open questions.
A [notes] message comes back as decisions, owners, and next actions.
If the bot is unsure which routine fits, it asks one clarifying question, and any payment or send-external action waits for your confirmation.

zh.title: 转发即触发：Bot 邮箱例行
zh.summary: Grok Bot 自带邮箱——邮件可触发例行。转发收据、发票或凌乱会议纪要，对应工作流就会跑起来。不用开应用：按一下转发即可。
zh.whyItWorks: 瓶颈往往是再开一个应用。用邮件转发触发，能在工作已有入口承接，把录入变成一个动作。
workflowSteps: 找到 Bot 的邮箱地址/收件箱。
定义 2–3 条邮件触发例行（如收据归档、发票解析、会议纪要整理）。
教会 Bot 如何判断走哪条（主题关键词、发件人或转发时加的标签）。
各转发一封样例，核对输出。
养成转发习惯：需要时加 [receipt] / [invoice] / [notes] 前缀。
zh.promptTemplate:
你拥有可触发例行的邮箱收件箱。

例行：
1）[receipt] — 提取商户、日期、金额、类别；返回一行流水。
2）[invoice] — 提取供应商、到期日、金额、支付状态；列出待确认问题。
3）[notes] — 把凌乱会议纪要整理为决策、负责人与下一步。

每封入站邮件：识别例行（标签/主题/正文），执行并回复结构化结果。若不确定，只问一个澄清问题。
zh.connectorsAndRoutines: 核心是 Bot 收件箱 + 来信触发例行。可选 Gmail 过滤器自动转发已标记邮件。支付或对外发送动作保留确认。
acceptanceChecklist: 把收据、发票或凌乱的会议纪要转发到 Bot 收件箱后，对应例行会运行，不必再打开另一个应用。
带 [receipt] 的邮件会回复为一行流水，包含商户、日期、金额和类别。
带 [invoice] 的邮件会回复供应商、到期日、金额、支付状态，以及待确认问题。
带 [notes] 的邮件会整理成决策、负责人和下一步。
若 Bot 无法判断该走哪条例行，只会问一个澄清问题；支付或对外发送会等你确认。

source.excerpt: Grok Bot tip: your bot has its own email inbox, and an email to it can trigger a routine. Forward a receipt, an invoice or messy meeting notes, and the right workflow runs on it. No app to open, just hit Forward. #GrokBot #AI
